recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If JSON example rendering regresses, track follow-up work in the active publisher/tooling repository rather than changing FHIR conformance source files.
issue_request: FHIR-20413 was a Published/Persuasive, auto-approved change request asking the IG Publisher to escape embedded namespace quotes when rendering generated JSON examples, because unescaped XHTML namespace attributes made displayed JSON invalid.
initial_application: HL7/fhir commit 89e7fddd8117f9b75c34a5057b193006c8b29793 directly applied the request by changing JsonXhtmlRenderer.value from Utilities.escapeXml(value) to Utilities.escapeXml(Utilities.escapeJson(value)).
additional_context: The affected IG Publisher source was removed from HL7/fhir by commit 56ceb0df08dd72381a4f98f1ea4ac5ea6d139a8b because it had gone to Maven. The current checkout has no tools/java directory, builds through external tooling, and the current HL7/fhir-ig-publisher JsonXhtmlRenderer still contains Utilities.escapeXml(Utilities.escapeJson(value)). No Confluence reference was found that would alter this conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No current FHIR specification source edit is appropriate because the affected renderer is outside this source checkout and the active external publisher source already preserves the requested escaping.
